verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents automations (rules, webhooks, online evaluations), but nothing in the evidence shows those automations can be versioned, reviewed before changes, or rolled back. The API path-versioning and deprecation policy cover LangSmith's own API, not user automations. Annotation queues review model outputs, not automation configurations. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
